history.name: The document carries its own type
history.description: The two typefaces the edition is set in travel inside the file itself rather than being fetched, so the finished document depends on nothing: it prints identically on a machine that has never seen those fonts, and generating one needs no network connection at all.
history.dev_notes: src/render/fonts.mjs embeds one static WOFF per weight as a data URI; the print step waits on document.fonts.ready, since network idle says nothing about fonts that were never fetched.
